newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht lower late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht lower late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was steady at around 14.50-15.00 in late trade compared with 15.00 in early morning and 14.50-15.00 late on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The interbank rate rose to as high as 15.50 percent in the morning. But the rate eased slightly in late trade," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the strong demand for funds by finance firms who must meet the Bank of Thailand's reserve requirements every Thursday helped sustain the interbank rate at the current high level.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.50 to the dollar against 25.53 on Tuesday.
